Tildes code block style uses triple tilde fences

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<pre><code>some code</code></pre>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(code_block_style: 'Tildes'))
puts result.inspect
```
